item.description: Katseye has been tapped to appear in a Super Bowl advertisement, which is set to air during next Monday’s National Football League championship broadcast. item.title: K-pop’s 1st Grammy-winning song ‘Golden’ maintains No.4 on Billboard chart
item.description: "Golden," from the original soundtrack of Netflix's 2025 animated film sensation "KPop Demon Hunters," placed fourth on the latest U.S. Billboard singles chart. According to Billboard's chart released Tuesday, "Golden" remained at No. 4 on the Hot 100 for a second consecutive week, extending its streak to 32 weeks on the chart. item.title: Boy band Cortis to perform at 2026 Ruffles NBA All-Star Celebrity Game
item.description: Boy band Cortis will stage a halftime show at the 2026 Ruffles NBA All-Star Celebrity Game, becoming the first K-pop act to headline a signature NBA event. The performance will take place on Feb. 13 at the Kia Forum in California, according to the NBA and ESPN on Wednesday. Cortis previously announced it had been chosen as the headliner of the “NBA Crossover” concert series at the Los Angeles Convention Center on Feb. 12. item.description: The Central Province Government has formally launched three major infrastructure projects at Bautama, marking what Governor, Rufina Peter, described as a shift from past development failures to disciplined, value-driven investment. item.description: Deputy Prime Minister John Rosso has issued a blunt assessment of Papua New Guinea’s development challenges, warning that the nation is "playing catch-up" after decades of failing to align infrastructure and essential services with a skyrocketing population. Speaking at the launch of the Central Province boom gate and market, Rosso highlighted the difference between the nation at Independence and the reality of 2026. item.title: DPM Rosso: PNG must redefine “Affordable Housing” as infrastructure costs climb
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Lands and Immigration, John Rosso, has called for a more realistic national conversation regarding housing, stating that "affordability" is being misunderstood while the cost of developing serviced land continues to skyrocket. Speaking on the housing crisis facing Papua New Guineans, Rosso challenged the vague use of the term "affordable," noting that the market is divided into three distinct brackets that require different strategies. item.title: PNG women’s 3×3 Basketball qualifies for Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games
item.description: In a landmark achievement for national sport, the Papua New Guinea Women’s 3x3 Basketball team has officially qualified for the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games. This marks the first time any PNG basketball squad has reached the Commonwealth stage, joining an elite field of just 12 nations globally.
